notes: All five identities were absent from docs/data/skills.json before this batch. Dedicated skill documentation explicitly establishes class/subcategory, Ki cost, and acquisition for each. The Super variants of Full Power Energy Wave and Special Beam Cannon are separate cast-exclusive identities and are not conflated with these Ultimate records.
